mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the straightening muscles completed the arm and showed why opposite movements require opposing pulls. That connected the muscle attachments to the joint's movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the two muscle groups was predictable once the front and rear slots appeared, though the resulting explanations gave the actions a purpose.

surprise.text: Joint fluid also helps nourish cartilage, which has no blood vessels of its own.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the pictures and goal made the sequence understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the arm construction connected material properties and muscle pulls to movement, and I would be curious to see how it connects to other body systems.
